title.original: Unleashing Efficient Asynchronous RL Post-Training via Staleness-Constrained Rollout Coordination
title.zh: 通过停滞约束的轨迹采样协调来释放高效的异步强化学习后训练
title.en: Unleashing Efficient Asynchronous RL Post-Training via Staleness-Constrained Rollout Coordination

inclusion_reason.zh: StaleFlow 用一致性协议、轨迹/参数服务和陈旧感知调度统一治理异步 RL 数据流，是后训练协调基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: StaleFlow uses a consistency protocol, trajectory and parameter services, and staleness-aware scheduling to govern asynchronous RL dataflow as post-training coordination infrastructure.

abstract.zh: StaleFlow 在解耦异步 RL 中联合处理轨迹陈旧和长度偏斜，通过全局一致性协议、轨迹/参数数据服务与陈旧感知调度协调 rollout。
abstract.en: StaleFlow jointly handles trajectory staleness and length skew in disaggregated asynchronous RL through a global consistency protocol, trajectory and parameter servers, and staleness-aware rollout scheduling.

problem.zh: 异步 rollout、奖励和训练提高利用率，却使轨迹基于旧参数生成；长度长尾又造成负载失衡，而单独优化任一问题常恶化另一个。
problem.en: Asynchronous rollout, reward, and training improve utilization but generate trajectories from old parameters; length tails create imbalance, and optimizing either issue alone often worsens the other.

approach.zh: 一致性协议跟踪每条轨迹全生命周期并限制版本差，数据服务解耦参数与轨迹流，调度器在陈旧预算内优先提高吞吐。
approach.en: A consistency protocol tracks every trajectory lifecycle and bounds version lag, data services decouple parameter and trajectory flow, and scheduling maximizes throughput within a staleness budget.

system_design.zh: 参数服务器发布策略版本，轨迹服务器缓存与分发样本，生命周期元数据连接 rollout 到训练消费；协调器根据长度和版本动态派发任务。
system_design.en: A parameter server publishes policy versions, a trajectory server buffers samples, lifecycle metadata links rollout to training consumption, and a coordinator dispatches work from length and version state.

key_results.zh: 评测显示 StaleFlow 在不牺牲收敛的情况下提高训练吞吐，证明陈旧与偏斜可以在一个协调层中共同控制。
key_results.en: Evaluation shows higher training throughput without loss of convergence, indicating that staleness and skew can be controlled jointly in one coordination layer.

limitations.zh: 全局协议和双数据服务增加元数据、存储与故障恢复复杂度；陈旧上限对不同算法和奖励分布需要重新校准。
limitations.en: The global protocol and dual data services add metadata, storage, and recovery complexity, while acceptable staleness bounds must be recalibrated for different algorithms and reward distributions.

workloads: asynchronous rollout, reward, and policy training

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
